serverDuration.method: Same-PID timestamp match, 1ms clock/rounding tolerance. Parse/Bind/Execute server duration events are separately summed. Ambiguous events are excluded from per-query groups.
serverDuration.scope: Projection-pool PIDs during the workload, including some snapshot metadata reads. Not a perfect one-to-one subtraction from the instrumented query union; ambiguous per-query timestamp matches are excluded.
